npcs.name: Sul-Matuul
npcs.greet: I am Ashkhan of the Urshilaku. Outlanders come here to buy, or to steal, or to preach. Which are you?

npcs.name: Nibani Maesa
npcs.greet: The ancestors whisper about strangers before they arrive. They were whispering about you this morning. Sit by the fire.

npcs.name: Shishara Assemanu
npcs.greet: Guar hides, kwama eggs, trama root. Honest goods, honest prices. Don't haggle like a Hlaalu and we'll get along.

npcs.name: Ranabi
npcs.greet: Gulakhan of the Erabenimsun. Urshilaku friend, are you? Then you're a long way from friends.

relics.name: Bull Netch Hide
relics.desc: A large, flawless netch hide, the kind a wise woman might use for a drum or a cloak.

relics.name: Ancestral Death-Mask
relics.desc: A bone mask from the Urshilaku burial caverns, stolen by grave robbers and recovered. It feels watched.

relics.name: Ash from the Dreaming Place
relics.desc: A pinch of fine grey ash from the slopes of Red Mountain, gathered at the place of Nibani's vision.

ash_reading: Sit. Close your eyes. Breathe the smoke. The ancestors will tell me what you are, and you will not like all of it.
A stranger who walks between camps. Not one of us, and not one of them. The ancestors find that funny. So do I.
ash_vision: On the slopes of Red Mountain, the ash wind drops all at once. In the silence, figures of smoke rise around you: hunters, mothers, children, and old wise women with bright eyes.
The mountain dreams, and its dreams are poison. Keep the clans together, stranger. Apart, the ash will bury them one by one.
ash_ashkhan: You came to us an outlander. You hunted with us, honored our wise woman, made peace with the Erabenimsun and brought our ancestors home.
The clan has spoken by the fire. When I am gone, they would follow you. Until then, sit beside me. You are Ashkhan in all but the title.
The ancestors are laughing again. This time, I think they are pleased.

quests.title: The Outlander's Hunt
quests.offer: How does an outlander earn the clans' trust?
quests.pitch: By being useful, the same as anyone. The Urshilaku camp in the north is short of meat and long on cliff racers. Go and hunt for them. Kill kagouti, kill racers, then show your face to Sul-Matuul. He'll decide if you're a friend.
quests.desc: Shishara Assemanu, an Ashlander trader outside Ald'ruhn, told me the Urshilaku clan might accept an outlander who hunts for them: kagouti for meat, cliff racers for peace.

objectives.text: Hunt three kagouti
Kill three cliff racers
Travel to the Urshilaku camp
Speak with Sul-Matuul, Ashkhan of the Urshilaku
objectives.topic: I've hunted kagouti and cliff racers for your camp.
objectives.reply: So the hunters told me. An outlander who brings meat and asks for nothing. Rare as rain. Sit at our fire, then, clanfriend.

quests.outro: I hunted for the Urshilaku and Sul-Matuul welcomed me to the clan's fire as an outlander friend.

consequence.summary: I hunted for the Urshilaku and Sul-Matuul welcomed me to the clan's fire as an outlander friend.

quests.title: A Gift for the Wise Woman
quests.offer: What would honor the wise woman of the Urshilaku?
quests.pitch: Honor. Such a big word for a small thing. I would like a bull netch hide, a good one, for a new spirit drum. The netch drift in the bitter coast winds to the south. Bring me one, and I will read your shadow for you.
quests.desc: Nibani Maesa, wise woman of the Urshilaku, asked for a bull netch hide for a new spirit drum. In return she will read my future.

objectives.text: Hunt a bull netch
Bring the hide to Nibani Maesa
objectives.topic: A bull netch hide, as you asked.
objectives.reply: Flawless. The drum will speak well. Now sit, and let me read you.

objectives.text: Answer the wise woman's question

choices.label: I want to learn your ways, not change them.
choices.reply: A good answer. The ancestors approve. Most outlanders say they want to learn and mean they want to buy.

choices.label: I came for adventure. I stayed for the people.
choices.reply: Honest. The ancestors like honest. They also like it when you bring meat.

quests.outro: I brought Nibani Maesa a bull netch hide. She read my shadow by the fire and seemed amused by what she saw.

consequence.summary: I brought Nibani Maesa a bull netch hide. She read my shadow by the fire and seemed amused by what she saw.

quests.title: Blood Between Clans
quests.pitch: The Erabenimsun have taken guar from our herds again. They are a hard clan with a cruel Ashkhan, but blood between clans helps no one but the mountain. Go to their camp. Speak with Ranabi, their Gulakhan. End this, one way or another.
quests.desc: The Erabenimsun clan has been raiding Urshilaku herds. Sul-Matuul wants the feud ended and has sent me to deal with Ranabi, the Erabenimsun Gulakhan.

objectives.text: Travel to the Erabenimsun camp
Speak with Ranabi
objectives.topic: Sul-Matuul wants an end to the raids.
objectives.reply: Does he? The Urshilaku have fat herds and we have ash. If he wants peace, he can pay for it. Or you can prove the Urshilaku have teeth.

objectives.text: Choose how to end the feud

choices.label: Then let your best hunter face me, and the winner sets the terms.
choices.reply: Ha! Bold. Very well. But my young hotbloods won't wait for a fair fight. Watch your back.

choices.label: The Urshilaku will share their grazing in the dry season, in exchange for peace.
choices.reply: Shared grazing? That's more than we'd win by raiding. Agreed. But some of my young bloods won't like it.

objectives.text: Fight off the young Erabenimsun raiders who reject the terms
objectives.journal: Three young hunters came at me rather than accept Ranabi's word. Ranabi watched, and when it was over he nodded, as if that settled everything. It did.

objectives.text: Report to Sul-Matuul
objectives.topic: The Erabenimsun will raid no more.
objectives.reply: No more? I have waited ten years to hear that. You have done the Urshilaku a great service, clanfriend.

quests.outro: I ended the feud between the Urshilaku and the Erabenimsun.

consequence.summary: I ended the feud between the Urshilaku and the Erabenimsun.

quests.title: The Robbed Ancestors
quests.desc: Grave robbers have broken into the Urshilaku burial caverns and taken the death-masks of the ancestors. The angry dead are walking, and Nibani Maesa has begged me to set things right.

objectives.text: Travel to the Urshilaku burial caverns
Kill the grave robbers
Put the restless ancestors back to rest
Recover the ancestral death-mask
Return the death-mask to Nibani Maesa
objectives.topic: The robbers are dead and the ancestors are quiet. This was taken.
objectives.reply: The mask of Hassour the Elder, who led the clan through the great ash fall. You've brought him home. The ancestors won't forget this. Neither will I.

quests.outro: I recovered the stolen death-masks from the Urshilaku burial caverns and laid the restless ancestors back to rest.

consequence.summary: I recovered the stolen death-masks from the Urshilaku burial caverns and laid the restless ancestors back to rest.

quests.title: Dream of the Mountain
quests.offer: The ancestors spoke to you about me?
quests.pitch: They want to speak to you themselves. Go to the slopes of Red Mountain at night, to the place where the ash lies smooth as water. Wait there. Something will come. Some of it will want to kill you.
quests.desc: Nibani Maesa says the ancestors want to speak to me directly, on the slopes of Red Mountain under the night sky.

objectives.text: Climb to the slopes of Red Mountain
Wait for night
Drive off the ash creatures drawn by the dreaming
Gather ash from the dreaming place
Tell Nibani Maesa what the ancestors said
objectives.topic: They told me to keep the clans together.
objectives.reply: Then that is your path. I will burn this ash on the fire tonight and the whole camp will dream your vision. Go to Sul-Matuul in the morning.

quests.outro: On the slopes of Red Mountain, the ancestors spoke to me: the clans must stand together, or the ash will bury them.

consequence.summary: On the slopes of Red Mountain, the ancestors spoke to me: the clans must stand together, or the ash will bury them.

quests.title: Ashkhan
quests.desc: Ash creatures driven by the mountain's dreams have come down on the Urshilaku camp. Sul-Matuul will need every spear, and after the fight, the clan will gather by the fire.

objectives.text: Hurry to the Urshilaku camp
Defend the camp from the ash creatures
Kill the Ash Ghoul leading them
Sit by the fire with Sul-Matuul
objectives.reply: Safe because of you. Stay. The clan has something to say.

quests.outro: I defended the Urshilaku camp from the mountain's creatures. Sul-Matuul and the clan named me Ashkhan-to-be, the first outlander so honored.

consequence.summary: I defended the Urshilaku camp from the mountain's creatures. Sul-Matuul and the clan named me Ashkhan-to-be, the first outlander so honored.
